 Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the
 Constitution of India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing
 the respondents 3 to 6 herein to pay compensation amount
 under Section 15(1) of Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001 for the
 acquisition of the petitioner's lands in T.S.No.2, 37 and 46/3 to
 an extent of 6872.21 sq.mts. situated at Sathamangalam
 Village, Madurai North Taluk, Madurai District for the
 formation of Vaigai river North bank road from Kurivikaran
 Salai to Anna Nagar under comprehensive road infrastructure
 development programme to the petitioner herein.

For Petitioner : Mr.A.Thiyagarajan,
 Senior Counsel,
 for M/s.S.Sundaravadivel.
 For Respondents: Mr.M.Prakash,
 Additional Government Pleader.

** *
 ORDER Heard the learned Senior counsel appearing for the writ petitioner and the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.
2. Vide notification dated 21.01.2022, notice under Section 15(1) of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001 was published in Tamil Nadu Government Gazette.

Gazette No.54 of the notification reads as follows:-
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis   3.

As per Section 16(1) of the Act, when a notice was issued under Section 15(1) of the Act in the Tamil Nadu https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Government Gazette, the notified land shall vest absolutely in the Government free from all encumbrances.
It is not known if actual possession has been taken over or not.
Be that as it may, in matters such as this, the land owner cannot be kept in a state of suspense.
The land had been acquired for constructing Vaigai river north bank from Kuruvikkaran Salai to Anna Nagar in 0/0-1/100km.
4. The learned Senior counsel would point out that the proceedings have been going on since 2020.
It appears that a firm decision is yet to be taken as regards alignment.
It is admitted that more than three months back, the relevant proposal has been submitted to the seventh respondent.
The seventh respondent is directed to take a call in the matter within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

Based on the order to be passed by the seventh respondent,
the authorities will know the exact extent of land that will be required for the present project.

This is of course subject to verification of the petitioner's title over the acquired land.

If lesser extent of land is proposed to be taken, consequential steps as contemplated under the proviso to Section 16(1) of the Act will be taken immediately thereafter so that the land not required is released from acquisition proceedings.
This writ petition stands disposed of.
